items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 122:1
items.html:
(to the question) Turbidity of the waters
The phases of the bottom Hey of the first restriction, which cannot receive the phase of the coagulation of the Yesod of Aba, which makes ZA into the phase of a firmament (See answer 37.), being included in the MAN of ZA, are discerned as the turbidity of the waters. (Part 1, Page 133, Item 21).
